title: The Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12

ai_review.summary: Rare 1982 “morning dew” show captured on a crisp sound‑board mix with standout Brent‑B3 on Not Fade Away and strong vocals from Jerry.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this early‑’82 West LA performance, calling it a collector’s gem thanks to the rare morning‑dew date and energetic set, especially the second half and the bright Brent‑organ work on “Not Fade Away.” The soundboard recording is generally clear and well‑balanced, though one listener notes an odd speed‑up that mars the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both performance (average ~4.6) and recording quality (average ~4.2); weighted rating yields ~4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑blended mix with clear vocals and keyboards; one reviewer reports the playback is sped‑up, which detracts from fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by a particularly praised second set; transitions and overall pacing described as strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals are strong and nuanced, though a few note he sounds a bit tired at times.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's B3 organ on “Not Fade Away” is highlighted as a bright, energetic addition; noted as the new kid having fun.
